description: This file is a Makefile for building the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt build system. It includes definitions for downloading, configuring, compiling, and cleaning kernel components, as well as handling dependencies and debug information.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the kernel build environment using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure
methods.description: Configures the kernel build using default configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage
methods.description: Compiles the kernel image and initramfs.

methods.name: Download/kernel
methods.description: Defines kernel download URL, file, and hash.

methods.name: Download/git-kernel
methods.description: Defines git repository options for kernel source.

methods.name: Kernel/CollectDebug
methods.description: Collects debug symbols and creates a debug tarball (conditional on CONFIG_COLLECT_KERNEL_DEBUG).
